company_news.headline: Cisco (CSCO) Joins AI Cybersecurity Alliance And Teams With Tech Mahindra On SSE
company_news.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS:CSCO) has joined an industry coalition to launch the Open Source AI Cybersecurity Alliance. The company also announced a partnership with Tech Mahindra to deliver an AI driven Security Service Edge (SSE) offering for global enterprises. Cisco Systems sits at the intersection of networking, security, and AI, areas that are drawing increasing attention from enterprises looking to protect cloud based and distributed work environments.
